content.short: Baltex is a cross-chain DEX aggregator unifying DEXs and bridges into a single swap terminal.
content.description: Baltex unifies DEXs, bridges, and aggregators into a single cross-chain swap terminal, solving fragmented liquidity and cumbersome bridging. Users connect a self-custody wallet, select from 1,000+ crypto assets, and receive an optimized route with transparent fees - no app-hopping. A Private mode leverages Monero-backed infrastructure to reduce on-chain traceability. Developers can access the same routing via a single API to power in-wallet swaps with broad coverage and reliable execution.

resources.title: Raydium vs Orca: Solana DEX Rates Compared
resources.tldr: Two Solana venues with different pool designs, compared on realised execution rather than headline fees. The gap between the two numbers is the interesting part.

resources.title: Balancer V3 Review: Custom Pools and Hooks
resources.tldr: Balancer's weighted and custom pools behave quite differently from a standard constant-product AMM. Goes into the hooks, the fee mechanics and the security surface they add.

resources.title: Curve Finance Review: Still Best for Stablecoin Swaps?
resources.tldr: Curve's invariant is built for assets that should trade near parity, which is why it wins on stables and loses elsewhere. Revisits whether that advantage still holds.
